strategies.name: TCC Database Manipulation via Launchctl and Unprotected SIP

analytics.name: Analytic 1474
analytics.guidance: Unauthorized modification of TCC.db followed by elevated process execution under a trusted parent (e.g., Finder, SystemUIServer) or via launchctl environment override. Also includes identification of SIP being disabled, which is highly uncommon and a prerequisite for this abuse path.

tuning.description: May vary across macOS versions and user contexts; defenders can tune for known benign cases.
Custom user paths or redirected SQLite DBs may require alternate matching logic.
Temporal proximity between launchctl setenv and subsequent privileged access can be tuned.
Frequency of SIP integrity checks may vary based on system hardening policies.

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
